name: Catfish Battery 1.5
body:
## Catfish Battery 1.5

Every page is now native Android views; the WebView is gone. The 3D pack, cells, sensor positions and the Cells switch are kept.

- **Status**
  - **New schematic layout.** The cards now step around the pack:
    - top: the HV PACK card with SOC, SOH, a `V × A = kW` line and an SOC sparkline;
    - middle: the Loads card;
    - bottom: DC-DC beside the 12 V battery.
  - **Straight wires** with flowing dots that follow the real energy direction.
  - **Plug badge, only while energy flows:**
    - AC Type 2 or CCS2 in green while charging, chosen from the real AC/DC handle signals;
    - AC Type 2 in blue for V2L power out;
    - nothing when idle, including when plugged in and full.
  - **Charging card.** While charging, the Loads card shows the charge: target, time left (`Full in 1 h 35 min` / `To 80 % in 22 min`) and energy added.
  - **Adaptive SOC sparkline.** It covers this charge (with the target), this trip (since leaving Park), or the last 24 h. It is at least 15 min wide and the axis at least 5 % tall, so a small drop is not exaggerated.
  - **Pack SOC after a restart.** SOC now shows right after the app restarts while parked, from the APVP `HvBattSoc` subscription.
  - **Smaller fixes:**
    - Temperatures use the sensor legend's colours.
    - The totals note reads `since …`.
    - Each legend sits over its own group.
    - The ▼/▲ markers, the Updated badge and the subtitle are removed.
- **Battery health (new Health tab)**
  - **BECM SOH reading.** The app reads the BECM's own SOH (UDS DID 0x496D, 0.01 % steps) through Dxapp's diagnostic middleware. This happens once per day, when the app opens with the car in Park. A gear guard re-checks Park every 100 ms, a busy channel is skipped, only one read request (22 49 6D) is sent, and the channel is always released. A spinner shows while it reads.
  - **History file.** `soh.csv` now records the source (BECM or canspi), the odometer and the cell spread with every reading. Older files are upgraded in place and keep their rows.
  - **Simple view:** the SOH ring, a verdict, and the rate per 10,000 km and per year with a 90 % projection. The rates appear only after 30 days of readings with at least one SOH change. Until then the page shows collection progress and a labelled since-new estimate.
  - **Expert view:** SOH against date, distance and cell spread, with least-squares trends (slope, R², n) and the latest readings.
- **Charging, History and Settings** were rebuilt natively with the same data and behaviour. Every time left is now shown as hours and minutes.

**Verified:** 193/193 unit tests, assembleRelease, lint with 0 errors (14 warnings).

**Car-verified on Geely EX5:**
- Installed in place over 1.4 with `pm install -r` (data preserved).
- The installed `base.apk` SHA-256 matches this asset.
- Status and Health open with live data.
- The BECM SOH read returned 96.44 %.

**Not yet exercised on the car:**
- a real charge with the AC or CCS2 badge;
- V2L power out;
- the "this trip" sparkline while driving;
- the first SOH row with an odometer value.

SHA-256: `1c1a3a5c11d2053261c2cc1cefee1cc158edb57944cea585bf01787dfd016888`
Signer SHA-256: `77ed0ffb4263c5a7ac30002cc79825c03068fc390eee0e446daf53ca2df37e46` (same as 1.2 to 1.4)

name: Catfish Battery 1.4
body:
## Catfish Battery 1.4

- **Reset totals** in Settings: clears the used, charged and regen totals and their cost now (tap twice to confirm). Charge history and settings are kept.
- **Auto reset**: off, every month, or every N months (2-12) on a chosen day. "Last day" follows the length of each month. Settings shows the next reset date. If the head unit sleeps through a reset day, the reset runs once on wake, dated that day. Changing the schedule never wipes totals already counted.
- Midnight Champagne night theme: gold and ivory instead of blue, with the SOC line and kW out now easy to tell apart.
- Wider Status schematic with larger side panels. The 3D pack, cells and sensor positions are unchanged from 1.3.
- README rewritten with on-car screenshots of every tab.

Verified: 56/56 unit tests, assembleRelease, lint 0 errors (15 warnings).

Car-verified on Geely EX5 (fw 1.3): installed in place over 1.3 (data preserved), the installed APK hash matches this asset, and all four tabs open with live data. Not exercised on the car: pressing Reset now, an automatic reset firing, a real charge logged by 1.4, and STR/sleep survival.

Signer SHA-256: `77ed0ffb4263c5a7ac30002cc79825c03068fc390eee0e446daf53ca2df37e46` (same as 1.2 and 1.3).

name: Catfish Battery 1.3
body:
## Catfish Battery 1.3

- Status header: connection state (Live / Stale / Reconnecting / No vehicle data) and "Updated Xs ago".
- Stale readings are dimmed and flagged instead of looking current.
- Missing data shows -- and is never confused with a real 0.
- Tap a cell or sensor on the pack to pin its detail and highlight its position.
- Max/min cells marked with a shape (▲/▼), not colour alone.
- Charging chart axis labels larger; History empty state explains when data appears.
- Pack schematic geometry unchanged.

Verified: 48/48 unit tests, assembleRelease, lint 0 errors, 20/20 browser layout states, Android 11 emulator.

Car-verified on Geely EX5 (fw 1.3): installed in place (data preserved), Status showed Live + "just now", 118/118 cells, 12/12 sensors, ▲/▼ markers on the max/min cell and sensor. Still not exercised on-car: Stale/Reconnecting states, a real charge session, and STR/sleep survival.

name: Catfish Battery 1.2
body:
## Catfish Battery 1.2

Standalone Geely EX5 battery monitor (`com.catfish.battery`, versionCode 3).

### Included
- Original 3D pack Schematic, energy-flow paths, sensor placement and Cells view.
- Full-window layout above the vehicle climate dock; navigation remains at the top.
- Status, Charging, History and Settings with day/night presentation.
- Independent read-only VHAL/APVP telemetry and background charge logger.

### Verification
- Standalone repository: release build and all 45 unit tests passed; Android lint has 0 errors and 14 warnings.
- 20 browser layout states passed from the production HTML.
- Actual Android 11 release-APK UI sweep passed before extraction, including Settings Save/reopen.
- This exact APK was installed on the car and pulled back with a matching SHA-256. The original 3D pack, all 118 cells/12 sensors and all four tabs were reviewed on the car.
- An independent rebuild has matching ZIP-entry hashes outside META-INF, but a different whole-file hash. This release deliberately retains the original on-car verified APK.

### Limits
- No real charge-session or head-unit STR/sleep-survival verification.
- No migration of CF charge history and no root-based range probe.
- Signed with the existing development certificate. Another machine's default debug key is not update-compatible; do not uninstall or clear data to work around a mismatch.
- No private signing key is included. See NOTICE.md for source provenance; this extraction does not establish a new license.

Download the APK and verify it using SHA256SUMS.
